verdict.rationale: Modal's own homepage says it can spawn async batch and long-running work in the background, which covers the background-execution half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows recurring schedules, cron, or event triggers, so a one-off background spawn is shown but not a self-running automation. missing for 10: documented scheduled/cron or trigger-based automations, configuration docs for autonomous recurring runs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Spawn async batch processing and long-running work in the background.
